result:
**I'd make every human being uncontrollably, almost painfully curious.**

Not "nicer." Not "peaceful." Not even smarter. Just *curious*—the raw, restless, slightly deranged kind that keeps you up at 3 a.m. because you suddenly need to understand why consciousness exists or how quantum entanglement actually works or what the hell your cat is really thinking.

If that single switch flipped, almost everything else we fight about would eventually collapse under its own weight. Dogma dies in the face of genuine curiosity. Tribalism looks stupid when you're more interested in what's true than in being right. Even greed and cruelty become less efficient when enough people are obsessed with understanding the systems they're trapped in.

Everything else—better technology, better societies, better selves—would be downstream of that one trait. Curiosity is the only force I know that reliably eats ignorance, dogma, and bullshit for breakfast without needing to be told to do so.

The world wouldn't become utopia. It would become *alive*. And that feels like the only change worth making.
